stories.title: 56th IFFI (Goa, 20–28 November)
stories.body: the Golden Peacock for Best Film went to the Vietnamese film Skin of Youth, directed by Ash Mayfair.

one_liners: 56th IFFI (Goa, 20–28 November) — the Golden Peacock for Best Film went to the Vietnamese film Skin of Youth, directed by Ash Mayfair.
